defects.summary: A term deposit’s interest at maturity is not recorded as income. endTerm’s creditInterest (renewed or moved to savings) and the paid-out branch post the interest but never call recordInterest. So it is missing from the year’s earnings, which the return taxes, and from the month’s income, which programFor and mayEnroll read. An Inherited student with $2,849,566 in Chase’s CD is credited $57,928.16 on 24 March 2027, but March’s income reads $276. Enroll on 1 April gives HUSKY D (measured: kind 'medicaid', from 1 June 2027) where the marketplace is due. By contrast, a savings account’s monthly interest (banking.ts payInterest) and a CD’s interest taken by hand (bank.take_term_interest) are both recorded.
